svg.aria-label: A panel of figures read from the GitHub API on 18 September 2026 for the account mdmosfikurrahman. 2,840 commits since 2021, of which 1,876 are in private organisation repositories, across 56 public repositories, of which 24 are primarily Java and 7 primarily C#. Commits per year, split into own and organisation repositories, run 2021 97 own and 0 organisation, 2022 4 own and 0 organisation, 2023 172 own and 0 organisation, 2024 81 own and 0 organisation, 2025 246 own and 456 organisation, 2026 364 own and 1,420 organisation. Public repositories by primary language run Java 24, C# 7, JavaScript 5, Jupyter Notebook 4, HTML 3, TeX 3, Other 5. Commits include private organisation repositories from 2025, when the current employer's work moved onto GitHub; only counts are read, never a repository name, description or content. Code written for earlier employers never lived on this account, which is why 2022, a full year of Java in production, reads as four commits. Language shares cover public repositories only and are counted by repository rather than by byte, because notebooks store their own rendered output.
svg.title: Public work, measured — read from the GitHub API
